diapositivas.codigoAnimacion:
<a-entity id="escena_estudio" position="0 0 0" scale="0.12 0.12 0.12">

    <!-- 1. ILUMINACIÓN COMPLETA DE LABORATORIO (Sombras, brillos metálicos y relieve óptico) -->
    <a-light type="ambient" color="#ffffff" intensity="1.15"></a-light>
    <a-light type="directional" color="#ffffff" intensity="1.4" position="0 6 4"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#00f0ff" intensity="2" distance="14" position="-2.5 2 3"></a-light>
    <a-light type="point" color="#fbbf24" intensity="1.8" distance="14" position="2.5 2 3"></a-light>

    <!-- 2. PLATAFORMA DE CALIBRACIÓN Y DIAL CIENTÍFICO (Base en el suelo) -->
    <a-entity position="0 -1.9 0">
        <a-ring radius-inner="3.3" radius-outer="3.5" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #00f0ff; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 0.85; opacity: 0.8; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -90 360 0; dur: 32000; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-ring>
        <a-ring radius-inner="2.4" radius-outer="2.55" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #fbbf24; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.75; opacity: 0.75; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: rotation; to: -90 -360 0; dur: 22000; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-ring>
        <a-ring radius-inner="1.5" radius-outer="1.62" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #34d399; emissive: #059669; emissiveIntensity: 0.8; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true; side: double">
        </a-ring>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 3. MICROSCOPIO CIENTÍFICO CON ESCÁNER LÁSER ACTIVO (Observación / Derecha Abajo) -->
    <a-entity position="3.3 -0.8 0.2" rotation="0 -30 0"
        animation="property: rotation; to: 0 -15 0; dir: alternate; dur: 4500; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Base pesada de hierro fundido -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.75" height="0.12" position="0 0 0" material="color: #1e293b; metalness: 0.8; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.6" height="0.08" position="0 0.1 0" material="color: #0f172a; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.1"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Brazo Curvo de Acero -->
        <a-box width="0.22" height="1.5" depth="0.25" position="-0.4 0.85 0" rotation="0 0 -15" material="color: #334155; metalness: 0.8; roughness: 0.2"></a-box>
        <!-- Platina mecánica con pinzas -->
        <a-box width="0.95" height="0.05" depth="0.85" position="0.05 0.75 0" material="color: #020617; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.1"></a-box>
        <!-- Portaobjetos con muestra celular fluorescente -->
        <a-box width="0.65" height="0.015" depth="0.25" position="0.05 0.79 0" material="color: #a5f3fc; opacity: 0.55; transparent: true; metalness: 0.9"></a-box>
        <a-circle radius="0.07" position="0.05 0.805 0" rotation="-90 0 0" material="color: #22c55e; emissive: #16a34a; emissiveIntensity: 1"></a-circle>
        
        <!-- HAZ LÁSER VERDE DE ESCANEO ACTIVO SUBIENDO Y BAJANDO SOBRE LA MUESTRA -->
        <a-ring radius-inner="0.1" radius-outer="0.28" position="0.05 0.82 0" rotation="-90 0 0"
            material="color: #4ade80; emissive: #22c55e; emissiveIntensity: 1; opacity: 0.7; transparent: true; side: double"
            animation="property: position; to: 0.05 1.15 0; dir: alternate; dur: 1400; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-ring>

        <!-- Condensador y Luz inferior -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.16" height="0.25" position="0.05 0.6 0" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #eab308; emissiveIntensity: 0.9"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Revólver con 3 Objetivos Lentes -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.32" height="0.1" position="0.05 1.45 0" material="color: #475569; metalness: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.35" position="0.05 1.25 0.15" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.1"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.4" position="0.05 1.25 -0.15" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.1"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.45" position="-0.1 1.25 0" material="color: #00f0ff; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.1"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Tubo Óptico con Ocular -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.14" height="0.8" position="0.05 1.9 0" rotation="0 0 -25" material="color: #0f172a; metalness: 0.8; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.18" height="0.2" position="-0.15 2.3 0" rotation="0 0 -25" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- Tornillo macrométrico -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.16" height="0.4" position="-0.4 0.9 0" rotation="90 0 0" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9"></a-cylinder>

        <!-- PLACA DE PETRI AL LADO DEL MICROSCOPIO -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.35" height="0.06" position="0.85 0.03 0.3" material="color: #e0f2fe; opacity: 0.45; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-circle radius="0.28" position="0.85 0.065 0.3" rotation="-90 0 0" material="color: #06b6d4; emissive: #0891b2; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-circle>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 4. MATRAZ ERLENMEYER CON MECHERO BUNSEN Y LLAMA REAL (Experimentación / Izquierda Abajo) -->
    <a-entity position="-3.3 -0.8 0.2" rotation="0 25 0">
        <!-- Mechero Bunsen en la base -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.38" height="0.08" position="0 -0.05 0" material="color: #334155; metalness: 0.9"></a-cylinder>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.08" height="0.35" position="0 0.12 0" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <!-- LLAMA DE FUEGO AZUL REACTIVA VIBRANTE (Animación de combustión) -->
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.09" radius-top="0.01" height="0.28" position="0 0.38 0"
            material="color: #38bdf8; emissive: #0284c7; emissiveIntensity: 1.5; opacity: 0.9; transparent: true"
            animation="property: scale; to: 0.85 1.3 0.85; dir: alternate; dur: 200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        </a-cone>
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.04" radius-top="0.005" height="0.16" position="0 0.35 0"
            material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #ffffff; emissiveIntensity: 2; opacity: 0.95; transparent: true">
        </a-cone>

        <!-- Soporte Universal de Varilla Metálica -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.04" height="2.2" position="-0.75 0.9 0" material="color: #64748b; metalness: 0.95"></a-cylinder>
        <a-box width="0.8" height="0.06" depth="0.08" position="-0.35 1.15 0" material="color: #475569; metalness: 0.85"></a-box>

        <!-- Matraz de Vidrio Pírex -->
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.8" radius-top="0.25" height="1.1" position="0 0.95 0"
            material="color: #e0f2fe; opacity: 0.35; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.9; side: double">
        </a-cone>
        <!-- Cuello y Reborde -->
        <a-cylinder radius="0.24" height="0.65" position="0 1.75 0"
            material="color: #e0f2fe; opacity: 0.35; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.9; side: double">
        </a-cylinder>
        <a-torus radius="0.24" radius-tubular="0.03" position="0 2.08 0" rotation="90 0 0"
            material="color: #bae6fd; opacity: 0.6; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.8">
        </a-torus>
        <!-- Líquido Reactivo Hirviente -->
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.75" radius-top="0.45" height="0.6" position="0 0.72 0"
            material="color: #06b6d4; emissive: #0891b2; emissiveIntensity: 0.75; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true">
        </a-cone>
        <!-- 3 Burbujas Químicas Ascendentes -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.05" position="-0.15 0.5 0.1" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #38bdf8; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: position; to: -0.15 1.05 0.1; dur: 1100; loop: true; easing: linear">
        </a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.065" position="0.2 0.45 -0.1" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #38bdf8; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: position; to: 0.2 1.05 -0.1; dur: 1500; loop: true; delay: 300; easing: linear">
        </a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.04" position="0 0.52 0.2" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #38bdf8; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: position; to: 0 1.05 0.2; dur: 1300; loop: true; delay: 650; easing: linear">
        </a-sphere>

        <!-- GRADILLA CON TUBOS DE ENSAYO DE COLORES AL LADO -->
        <a-entity position="0.95 0.3 0.2">
            <!-- Soporte / Gradilla de madera noble -->
            <a-box width="0.8" height="0.05" depth="0.3" position="0 0 0" material="color: #78350f"></a-box>
            <a-box width="0.8" height="0.05" depth="0.3" position="0 0.5 0" material="color: #78350f"></a-box>
            <!-- Tubo 1: Reactivo Rojo -->
            <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.6" position="-0.25 0.3 0" material="color: #e0f2fe; opacity: 0.4; transparent: true"></a-cylinder>
            <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.35" position="-0.25 0.2 0" material="color: #ef4444; emissive: #b91c1c; emissiveIntensity: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
            <!-- Tubo 2: Reactivo Verde -->
            <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.6" position="0 0.3 0" material="color: #e0f2fe; opacity: 0.4; transparent: true"></a-cylinder>
            <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.4" position="0 0.22 0" material="color: #22c55e; emissive: #15803d; emissiveIntensity: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
            <!-- Tubo 3: Reactivo Dorado -->
            <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.6" position="0.25 0.3 0" material="color: #e0f2fe; opacity: 0.4; transparent: true"></a-cylinder>
            <a-cylinder radius="0.06" height="0.3" position="0.25 0.18 0" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #ca8a04; emissiveIntensity: 0.8"></a-cylinder>
        </a-entity>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 5. CADENA DE ADN MOLECULAR ROTATORIA (Izquierda Arriba) -->
    <a-entity position="-2.9 1.8 0.3"
        animation="property: rotation; to: 0 360 0; dur: 8500; loop: true; easing: linear"
        animation__pos="property: position; to: -2.9 2.05 0.3; dir: alternate; dur: 2600; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 0.6 0" rotation="0 0 90" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="-0.45 0.6 0" material="color: #ef4444; emissive: #b91c1c; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0.45 0.6 0" material="color: #3b82f6; emissive: #1d4ed8; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 0.2 0" rotation="0 45 90" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="-0.32 0.2 0.32" material="color: #eab308; emissive: #ca8a04; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0.32 0.2 -0.32" material="color: #22c55e; emissive: #15803d; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 -0.2 0" rotation="90 0 0" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0 -0.2 0.45" material="color: #06b6d4; emissive: #0891b2; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0 -0.2 -0.45" material="color: #a855f7; emissive: #7e22ce; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.03" height="0.9" position="0 -0.6 0" rotation="0 -45 90" material="color: #94a3b8"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="-0.32 -0.6 -0.32" material="color: #ef4444; emissive: #b91c1c; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0.32 -0.6 0.32" material="color: #3b82f6; emissive: #1d4ed8; emissiveIntensity: 0.7"></a-sphere>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 6. LUPA DE OBSERVACIÓN ÓPTICA CIENTÍFICA (Derecha Arriba) -->
    <a-entity position="2.9 1.8 0.3" rotation="-15 25 -20"
        animation="property: position; to: 2.9 2.05 0.3; dir: alternate; dur: 2800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine"
        animation__rot="property: rotation; to: -10 35 -15; dir: alternate; dur: 3800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <a-torus radius="0.55" radius-tubular="0.04" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.95; roughness: 0.15; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.4"></a-torus>
        <a-circle radius="0.53" material="color: #a5f3fc; opacity: 0.45; transparent: true; roughness: 0.1; metalness: 0.9; side: double"></a-circle>
        <a-plane width="0.15" height="0.45" position="0.2 0.2 0.01" rotation="0 0 -40" material="color: #ffffff; opacity: 0.6; transparent: true"></a-plane>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.07" height="0.9" position="0 -0.95 0" material="color: #78350f; roughness: 0.4"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.09" position="0 -1.4 0" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.95; roughness: 0.15"></a-sphere>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 7. BOMBILLA DE IDEAS E HIPÓTESIS / EUREKA CON ÁTOMO CIENTÍFICO (Centro Cúspide) -->
    <a-entity position="0 2.8 0.1"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 3.02 0.1; dir: alternate; dur: 2400; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <!-- Globo de cristal -->
        <a-sphere radius="0.45" material="color: #fef08a; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true; emissive: #facc15; emissiveIntensity: 0.95"></a-sphere>
        <a-cone radius-bottom="0.42" radius-top="0.22" height="0.3" position="0 -0.32 0" material="color: #fef08a; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true; emissive: #facc15; emissiveIntensity: 0.95"></a-cone>
        <a-cylinder radius="0.2" height="0.25" position="0 -0.58 0" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-sphere radius="0.12" position="0 -0.72 0" material="color: #334155; metalness: 0.8"></a-sphere>
        <!-- Filamento brillante de tungsteno -->
        <a-torus radius="0.16" radius-tubular="0.02" position="0 0 0" material="color: #ffffff; emissive: #ffffff; emissiveIntensity: 2"></a-torus>
        <!-- Rayos de hipótesis pulsantes -->
        <a-octahedron radius="0.12" position="-0.75 0.3 0" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #eab308; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: scale; to: 1.5 1.5 1.5; dir: alternate; dur: 800; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine"></a-octahedron>
        <a-octahedron radius="0.12" position="0.75 0.3 0" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #eab308; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: scale; to: 1.5 1.5 1.5; dir: alternate; dur: 800; loop: true; delay: 400; easing: easeInOutSine"></a-octahedron>
        <a-octahedron radius="0.12" position="0 0.85 0" material="color: #facc15; emissive: #eab308; emissiveIntensity: 1"
            animation="property: scale; to: 1.5 1.5 1.5; dir: alternate; dur: 800; loop: true; delay: 200; easing: easeInOutSine"></a-octahedron>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 8. GRAN LIBRO ABIERTO DE METODOLOGÍA CON COMPÁS DE MEDICIÓN (Centro Abajo) -->
    <a-entity position="0 -1.35 0.5" rotation="28 0 0"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 -1.22 0.5; dir: alternate; dur: 3200; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">
        <a-cylinder radius="0.08" height="1.6" position="0 0 -0.05" rotation="90 0 0" material="color: #d97706; metalness: 0.85; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
        <a-box width="1.15" height="0.06" depth="1.55" position="-0.56 0.05 0" rotation="0 0 14" material="color: #fffbeb; roughness: 0.9"></a-box>
        <a-box width="1.2" height="0.04" depth="1.6" position="-0.58 0.01 0" rotation="0 0 14" material="color: #1e1b4b; roughness: 0.4"></a-box>
        <a-plane width="0.8" height="1.15" position="-0.54 0.09 0" rotation="-90 14 0" material="color: #0284c7; opacity: 0.5; transparent: true"></a-plane>
        <a-box width="1.15" height="0.06" depth="1.55" position="0.56 0.05 0" rotation="0 0 -14" material="color: #fffbeb; roughness: 0.9"></a-box>
        <a-box width="1.2" height="0.04" depth="1.6" position="0.58 0.01 0" rotation="0 0 -14" material="color: #1e1b4b; roughness: 0.4"></a-box>
        <a-plane width="0.8" height="1.15" position="0.54 0.09 0" rotation="-90 -14 0" material="color: #d97706; opacity: 0.5; transparent: true"></a-plane>
        <a-box width="0.1" height="0.02" depth="1.75" position="0 0.08 0.1" material="color: #fbbf24; emissive: #d97706; emissiveIntensity: 0.6"></a-box>

        <!-- COMPÁS METÁLICO CIENTÍFICO ABIERTO SOBRE LAS PÁGINAS -->
        <a-entity position="0 0.14 0.2" rotation="-90 0 0">
            <a-cylinder radius="0.02" height="0.6" position="-0.12 0 0" rotation="0 0 20" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
            <a-cylinder radius="0.02" height="0.6" position="0.12 0 0" rotation="0 0 -20" material="color: #facc15; metalness: 0.9; roughness: 0.2"></a-cylinder>
            <a-sphere radius="0.04" position="0 0.3 0" material="color: #94a3b8; metalness: 0.9"></a-sphere>
        </a-entity>
    </a-entity>

    <!-- 9. HUD HOLOGRÁFICO LATERAL DE DATOS CIENTÍFICOS (Estilo Sci-Fi Lab) -->
    <!-- Mini-Panel Izquierdo: Variables de la Investigación -->
    <a-plane width="1.6" height="0.9" position="-2.7 0.3 0.6" rotation="0 20 0"
        material="color: #0f172a; opacity: 0.8; transparent: true; roughness: 0.5">
        <a-text value="[ VARIABLES ]\n• X: Causa (Indep)\n• Y: Efecto (Dep)\n• Control: 100%" color="#38bdf8" width="2.2" position="0 0 0.02" align="center"></a-text>
    </a-plane>

    <!-- Mini-Panel Derecho: Validación y Certeza -->
    <a-plane width="1.6" height="0.9" position="2.7 0.3 0.6" rotation="0 -20 0"
        material="color: #0f172a; opacity: 0.8; transparent: true; roughness: 0.5">
        <a-text value="[ EVIDENCIA ]\n• Estado: Valido\n• Datos: Rigurosos\n• Certeza: 99.8%" color="#4ade80" width="2.2" position="0 0 0.02" align="center"></a-text>
    </a-plane>

    <!-- 10. EL TEXTO FLOTANTE ULTRA-LEGIBLE CON CAMBIO DE COLOR EN 60 FPS (Al frente: Z = 0.9) -->
    <a-entity position="0 0.4 0.9"
        animation="property: position; to: 0 0.55 0.9; dir: alternate; dur: 2500; loop: true; easing: easeInOutSine">

        <!-- Panel de contraste protector oscuro -->
        <a-plane width="4.9" height="2.2" position="0 0.1 -0.06"
            material="color: #030712; opacity: 0.85; transparent: true; roughness: 0.5">
        </a-plane>

        <!-- Insignia Superior -->
        <a-plane width="3.4" height="0.38" position="0 0.98 0.01"
            material="color: #0f172a; opacity: 0.95; transparent: true">
            <a-text value="🎓 METODO CIENTIFICO • UNIDAD I" align="center" color="#38bdf8" width="3.6" position="0 0 0.02"></a-text>
        </a-plane>

        <!-- CAPA GLOW TRASERA (Cambia de color automáticamente con app.js) -->
        <a-text 
            class="texto-glow-cambiante"
            value="Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de Metodologia\nde Investigacion" 
            color="#00f0ff" 
            align="center" 
            width="4.9"
            line-height="62"
            position="0.02 0.22 -0.01">
        </a-text>

        <!-- CAPA PRINCIPAL FRONTAL (Cambia de color en bucle continuo a 60 FPS) -->
        <a-text 
            class="texto-color-cambiante"
            value="Bienvenidos a la clase de\nFundamentos de Metodologia\nde Investigacion" 
            color="#ffffff" 
            align="center" 
            width="4.7"
            line-height="62"
            position="0 0.22 0.02">
        </a-text>

        <!-- SUBTÍTULO: LAS 4 FASES DEL MÉTODO CIENTÍFICO (Cambia de color) -->
        <a-text 
            class="texto-acento-cambiante"
            value="✦ Observacion  •  Hipotesis  •  Experimentacion  •  Tesis ✦" 
            color="#fbbf24" 
            align="center" 
            width="3.6"
            position="0 -0.58 0.02">
        </a-text>
    </a-entity>

</a-entity>
